notes.title: All of Game development stage is very smooth!
notes.content:
Players! 
Last time I posted release date changed to August 5th from July 20th.

All of game development stage is very smooth, And tomorrow, Finally The ball flow Nature and Light entrance to test stage! It mean that game be completed, and only remain Adjusting for small change.

Thank you for people who waiting my game, and I hope everyone enjoy my game!

Again, Deep thank you!

notes.title: Sorry for Change the release date.
notes.content:
Hello, Players! 
With Hard mind, Announce that I change release date to August 5th. It Is 15 days later than I first posted.
These days I'm not good at my game development. My laziness caused this situation.

Deeply sorry to say about it.
Actually, Game might end before July 20th, But I'm not sure that I won't finish it. 
So, I decided to delay release. I'm sure that you guys can check all of the full work on August 5th.
Again Deeply Sorry for Change the release date.

Regardless, Thank you.
